title: PTv nights — spoken direction (Fish TTS, slow guide voice)
voice: slow guide (community Osho-style voice — direction label only, never worn as identity)
note: Direction only. The Sanskrit sounds themselves always come from the attested chant clips, never the TTS. Powers worded identically to ptv_nights.json (Jaideva Singh recension). Round counts and pacing are ASSEMBLY.

nights.intro: Night one. Two sounds, a and aa. Sit upright, hands resting. Breathe naturally, never forcing the breath. Each sound is chanted aloud, touched at its place, and heard.
dirs: First sound, a, at the forehead. a is consciousness itself, the unsurpassable ground. Listen once, then chant aloud.
Second sound, aa, at the mouth. aa is bliss, the ground enjoying itself. Listen once, then chant aloud.
nights.close: Rest now in silence. One question, not to answer, only to feel. Was there an I hearing the sounds, or were the sounds arising in the I? The loop continues on its own. To stop, clear the canvas.

nights.intro: Night two. Two sounds, i and ee. Sit upright, hands resting. Breathe naturally, never forcing the breath.
dirs: First sound, i, at the right eye. i is the will to manifest, still untouched by objectivity. Listen once, then chant aloud.
Second sound, ee, at the left eye. ee is mastery, will now coloured by objectivity. Listen once, then chant aloud.
nights.close: Rest now in silence. Was there an I hearing the sounds, or were the sounds arising in the I? The loop continues on its own. To stop, clear the canvas.

nights.intro: Night three. Two sounds, u and oo. Sit upright, hands resting. Breathe naturally, never forcing the breath.
dirs: First sound, u, at the right ear. u is the opening of knowing, the power of knowledge. Listen once, then chant aloud.
Second sound, oo, at the left ear. oo is the waning of knowing, whence the appearance of objects begins. Listen once, then chant aloud.
nights.close: Rest now in silence. Was there an I hearing the sounds, or were the sounds arising in the I? The loop continues on its own. To stop, clear the canvas.

nights.intro: Night four. Two sounds, ri and ree. Sit upright, hands resting. Breathe naturally, never forcing the breath. The second sound has no recording. It is held in silence.
dirs: First sound, ri, at the right nostril. ri is the imperishable seed, subject to no change. Listen once, then chant aloud.
Second sound, ree, at the left nostril. No recording exists here. Touch the place and breathe. Hold the field in silence.
nights.close: Rest now in silence. Was there an I hearing the sounds, or were the sounds arising in the I? The loop continues on its own. To stop, clear the canvas.

nights.intro: Night five. Two sounds, li and lee. Neither has a recording. This night is touch and breath only. Sit upright, hands resting. Breathe naturally.
dirs: First place, li, at the right cheek. This is a void pause. It binds nothing. Touch the place and breathe, no sound.
Second place, lee, at the left cheek. A void pause. Touch the place and breathe, no sound.
nights.close: Rest now in silence. Was there an I holding the silence, or was the silence holding the I? The loop continues on its own. To stop, clear the canvas.

nights.intro: Night six. Two sounds, e and ai. Sit upright, hands resting. Breathe naturally, never forcing the breath.
dirs: First sound, e, at the lower teeth. e is the indistinct power of activity, action still formless. Listen once, then chant aloud.
Second sound, ai, at the upper teeth. ai is the distinct power of activity, action taking shape. Listen once, then chant aloud.
nights.close: Rest now in silence. Was there an I hearing the sounds, or were the sounds arising in the I? The loop continues on its own. To stop, clear the canvas.

nights.intro: Night seven. Two sounds, o and au. Sit upright, hands resting. Breathe naturally, never forcing the breath.
dirs: First sound, o, at the lower lip. o is the more distinct power of activity. Listen once, then chant aloud.
Second sound, au, at the upper lip. au is the most distinct power of activity, action complete. Listen once, then chant aloud.
nights.close: Rest now in silence. Was there an I hearing the sounds, or were the sounds arising in the I? The loop continues on its own. To stop, clear the canvas.

nights.intro: Night eight. Two sounds, am and ah. Sit upright, hands resting. Breathe naturally, never forcing the breath. Tonight the alphabet gathers itself back.
dirs: First sound, am, at the crown. am is the undivided knowledge of the universe, the holder of diversity. Listen once, then chant aloud.
Second sound, ah, at the tongue. ah is emission itself. The lower point expands the world. The upper point rests it all in I-consciousness. Listen once, then chant aloud.
nights.close: Rest now in silence. Let all fifty differentiations contract toward the single I that heard them. Was there ever anything but that I? The loop continues on its own. To stop, clear the canvas.
